segment.timestamp_policy: 30 fps assumed; timestamps synthesized as (local frame index) * 1000/30 ms because images carry no timestamps

detector.name: onnx-runtime-detector
detector.produces: untrusted RawDetection records in processed-image pixels
detector.timing_scope: detector call wall time: preprocessing + session.run + decode/NMS/coordinate inversion; not pure ONNX inference time
notes: The model artifact is a local, Git-ignored deployment file.
trained_accuracy_reported is null: repository metrics are not reproduced at load time.
Predictions are visual estimates and are validated downstream.
The detector is not connected to the connectome or plasticity.

limitations: Segments come from one recording group; they are not independent recordings.
Frames carry no source timestamps; 30 fps is assumed and timestamps are synthesized as (local frame index) * 1000/30 ms.
The detector was trained on this recording group; the group is held out by the fixed split, but detections on it are not an independent estimate of detector accuracy.
Event timestamps and feature values are perception output, not ground truth about the scene.
